reviewNotes: The source states the event date as 3–7 March 2021 but also describes it as a four-day scientific program; both source statements are preserved.
Dr. Basel Masri's roles are historical page copy ('ArLAR President JSR President') and should not be treated as current office-holder data.
YouTube upload dates are media metadata and are often months/years after the March 2021 congress; they are not congress-session dates.

Some video titles or track labels contain source spelling/casing inconsistencies (for example 'Musculoskeltal', varying ArLAR21 capitalization, and extra whitespace). Source wording is preserved; normalized track whitespace is provided separately.
Two gallery titles are visibly truncated in the source (Thao Pham and Jean Yves Reginster). Their full talk titles are recovered from the VideoObject description field.
For John Kanis, the source gallery name contains the symposium label while the VideoObject description contains the actual talk title. Both fields are preserved separately.
The source page contains 80 distinct VideoObject entries across five Wix video-gallery ItemLists.

pageCopy.replayIntro: During the unprecedented times of the Covid-19 pandemic in March 2021, the ArLAR21 Jordan e-Congress pivoted to a fully online format. We understand that attendees may have missed certain sessions. Therefore, we've curated all the e-Congress recordings and sessions here, allowing you to catch up or revisit them at your leisure. Dive into the comprehensive content and enhance your ArLAR21 experience from the comfort of your home.
pageCopy.theme: Raising awareness of high-quality Rheumatology practice to empower Rheumatologists in the Arab world to excel in their specialty
pageCopy.covidPostponement: The Jordanian Society of Rheumatology- JSR is pleased to announce the upcoming “Arab League of Associations for Rheumatology- ArLAR Congress: Ar LAR 21 Jordan e-Congress , which will be held in conjunction with the 6th International e-Congress of the Jordanian Society of Rheumatology from 3-7 March 2021, in a virtual set-up
pageCopy.themeExplanation: As you are aware, our congress was supposed to be held last year, but due to COVID-19 Pandemic, we were forced to postpone it and to cope with the virtual transformation with ArLAR College©.
pageCopy.programDescription: The main theme of the Ar LAR 21 Jordan e-Congress is “Raising awareness of high-quality Rheumatology practice to empower Rheumatologists in the Arab world to excel in their specialty”. The theme reflects the growing recognition of the power and importance of exchanging cutting-edge scientific and clinical information to improve patient care. The e-Congress aims to further knowledge in the Rheumatology field, contributing significantly to a better understanding of the complexity of diseases, addressing updates in their pathogenesis and management. It presents an opportunity to listen to top speakers, network with renowned Rheumatologists from the Arab region and around the world, leading to an enhanced output of research and improved care in the field.
programItems: The Ar LAR 21 Jordan e-Congress is a four-day scientific program, which will be of high interest to academicians, physicians, researchers, and others with an interest in Rheumatology, where distinguished and renowned speakers will deliver remarkable presentations, workshops, and poster sessions.
